title: Influence of Boolean pseudo-juntas
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses, and let $h$ take values in $\\{-1,1\}$ on its outcome space. If $h$ is a $K$-pseudo-junta, meaning its expected number of exposed coordinates is at most $K$, then its total influence satisfies $I(h)\le 4K$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite product probability space with strictly positive atom masses
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $h:\Omega\to\{-1,1\}$, and $K\in\mathbb R$. If $h$ is determined by locally triggered coordinate observations whose expected exposed size is at most $K$, with each trigger depending only on its declared coordinate set, then $I(h)\le4K$.
